summary.en: Chinese Maritime Militia vessels carried out dangerous maneuvers against the Philippine patrol boat BRP Cabra and its RHIB, and two CMMVs were repelled after anchoring illegally, while the number of Chinese vessels monitored in the West Philippine Sea rose to 48 following the ASEAN Summit 2026. The Philippines and France conducted joint naval exercises that tested operational capabilities, and the Philippines and Japan added five new Coast Guard vessels to their maritime security cooperation, while Finland signed a maritime security pact that includes Australian assistance for drones and cybersecurity. A 28‑year-old man was killed by his younger brother in a stabbing in Ozamiz City. 176 battle-related deaths were reported in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kinesiske maritime militsfartøyer utførte farlige manøvrer mot den filippinske patruljebåten BRP Cabra og dens RHIB, og to CMMV-er ble avvist etter å ha ankret ulovlig, mens antallet kinesiske fartøyer som ble overvåket i Vestfilippinske hav økte til 48 etter ASEAN-toppmøtet 2026. Filippinene og Frankrike gjennomførte felles marineøvelser som testet operasjonelle evner, og Filippinene og Japan la til fem nye kystvaktskip i sitt maritime sikkerhetssamarbeid, mens Finland signerte en maritim sikkerhetsavtale som inkluderer australsk bistand for droner og cybersikkerhet. En 28‑år gammel mann ble drept av sin yngre bror i en knivstikk i Ozamiz City. 176 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble rapportert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
